scope: Source identities, public routes and inspected text locations. Original article snapshots are not redistributed in the database archive; hashes identify the retained access evidence, not a promise that a live server returns identical bytes.

sources.title: A GSK3-binding peptide from FRAT1 selectively inhibits the GSK3-catalysed phosphorylation of axin and beta-catenin.
sources.operative_scope: Normal abstract, official metadata, both source-specific human IntAct kinase-assay records and explicit target/partner feature fields.
sources.finding: Engineered epsilon534–547 peptide with substitutions/phosphoserine544 associates with GSK3B in kinase assays; partner class is independently verified.
sources.limits: Publisher PDF HTTP403; no intact epsilon/native-complex claim.

sources.title: Characterization of the mammalian initiation factor eIF2B complex as a GDP dissociation stimulator protein.
sources.operative_scope: Author-uploaded original, selected factor-preparation, chromatography, subunit-analysis and GDP-dissociation Methods/Results (captured text lines 468–721).
sources.finding: Native human five-subunit complex depleted of eIF2 supports exchange and cytoplasmic complex membership.
sources.limits: Not a full-paper or isolated-epsilon preparation claim.

sources.title: Eukaryotic initiation factor 2B: identification of multiple phosphorylation sites in the epsilon-subunit and their functions in vivo.
sources.operative_scope: Original Introduction paragraphs 4–6 (secondary account of insulin-dependent epsilon regulation); Results paragraphs 39–41 and Figure 8 (rat epsilon full-length/truncation GSK3 docking and phosphorylation); previously inspected paragraphs 10,16,43–49,54–58,61,63,65,67,69. Text and captions, not figure pixels.
sources.finding: Native human phosphorylation is separate from detailed recombinant rat epsilon mutants. Rat S712/713GA changes eIF2 association/complex exchange; free epsilon activity is very low relative to assembled complex.
sources.limits: Rat residue numbers not mapped to human without alignment; no complete supplemental vector inspection.

sources.title: Role of translation initiation factor 2B in control of cell survival by the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/Akt/glycogen synthase kinase 3beta signaling pathway.
sources.operative_scope: Saved PMC indexed Methods10/17–20, Results23–45/47, Discussion49–54; exact causal reread included resistant-mutant, tau and cycloheximide controls.
sources.finding: Rat epsilon S535A/S539A constructs in Rat1/PC12 preserve translation and resist GSK3/PI3K-inhibitor/serum-withdrawal apoptosis. Phosphorylation inhibits pro-translation activity; no active WT epsilon proapoptotic step established.
sources.limits: No universal antiapoptotic function or opposite NEW. Figure captions/text read, not pixels. MAO is role scope, not a conclusion from WT overexpression alone.

sources.title: Mammalian stress granules represent sites of accumulation of stalled translation initiation complexes.
sources.operative_scope: Publisher-indexed original Results, Figures 1–2 captions and Discussion, including the fixation comparison. Direct publisher requests failed; complete Methods and figure pixels were not inspected.
sources.finding: Endogenous mouse NIH3T3 epsilon shows nuclear and cytoplasmic staining and stress-granule redistribution; current Q8CHW4 IDA donor is genuine.
sources.limits: Positive mouse localization is retained; fixation affects relative staining, and this does not establish exclusive human nuclear residence.

sources.title: Exp5 exports eEF1A via tRNA from nuclei and synergizes with other transport pathways to confine translation to the cytoplasm.
sources.operative_scope: Selected original Results, Methods and captions concerning eIF2B-epsilon–eGFP, nuclear-localization-signal constructs and leptomycin B; indexed paragraphs 9,18,49,50,52,53,55,57–60,69–71,90,91.
sources.finding: Human epsilon-eGFP in BHK cells shows basal cytoplasm/nuclear exclusion; engineered NLS plus leptomycin experiments have different scope.
sources.limits: No complete insert-sequence verification or universal nuclear-exclusion claim; text/captions read, not pixels.

sources.title: A severe variant of childhood ataxia with central hypomyelination/vanishing white matter leukoencephalopathy related to EIF21B5 mutation.
sources.operative_scope: Verified abstract; full original unavailable.
sources.finding: Homozygous EIF2B5 severe disease with low uric acid/elevated GDP sugars; heat-specific experiment not exposed.
sources.limits: Publisher failure; no title/abstract-only wrong-gene claim.

sources.title: Ovarian failure related to eukaryotic initiation factor 2B mutations.

sources.finding: Seven mutated patients include EIF2B5 R113H homozygotes and R113H/R195C; ovarian failure and white-matter disease are positive clinical evidence.
sources.limits: No follicle-development assay; complete table cells not reproduced in the normal cache.

sources.title: eIF2B-related disorders: antenatal onset and involvement of multiple organs.
sources.operative_scope: Original Methods, clinical/MRI Results and Table 1; indexed paragraphs 14–28, including MRI Results 18, caption 20 and Table 1 at 26.

sources.limits: Clinical/pathological observations do not themselves identify a direct epsilon myelin-sheath formation step.

sources.title: Decreased guanine nucleotide exchange factor activity in eIF2B-mutated patients.
sources.operative_scope: Author-uploaded original, selected Methods, Table 1 and GDP-dissociation Results (captured text lines 336–786).

sources.title: Mutations linked to leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter impair the function of the eukaryotic initiation factor 2B complex in diverse ways.
sources.operative_scope: Partial normal original text plus externally recovered full-length cloning, complex-formation Results and Figure 1 caption. The normal cache does not contain the complete Methods.
sources.finding: Full-length sequence-verified human clones in HEK293; gamma binds epsilon in a two-subunit expression context, delta is recovered with assembled complex. Human epsilon variants affect exchange/substrate association.
sources.limits: Cache flag true does not imply complete Methods; selected recovered sections only. No synthesized insert-to-current-reference equivalence assumed.

sources.title: The life and death of oligodendrocytes in vanishing white matter disease.
sources.operative_scope: Author-uploaded original, selected autopsy Methods, genotypes, quantification and Discussion; captured text lines 250–661, 477–1200, 1360–1545 and 1864–1882 in the saved views.
sources.finding: Four patients have EIF2B5 and one EIF2B2; oligodendrocyte density, apoptosis-associated staining and myelin pathology measured. Increased density has unresolved proliferation/survival explanations.
sources.limits: Selected original windows, not complete-paper/pixel inspection; no lineage-progress assay inferred.

sources.title: Screening for known mutations in EIF2B genes in a large panel of patients with premature ovarian failure.
sources.operative_scope: Original Methods, Results and Discussion; indexed paragraphs 14–34.
sources.finding: 93 isolated POF women were negative for screened known variants; prior positive ovarioleukodystrophy is discussed, not experimentally recapitulated.
sources.limits: No assertion that all ovarian EIF2B5 variants were excluded.

sources.title: EIF2B5 mutations compromise GFAP+ astrocyte generation in vanishing white matter leukodystrophy.
sources.operative_scope: Normal abstract, Nature publisher preview, figure titles3/4 and available supplement link metadata.
sources.finding: Affected human cultures produce few abnormal GFAP-positive astrocytes; normal human glial-progenitor EIF2B5 RNAi impairs GFAP induction. Normal-appearing oligodendrocytes reported.
sources.limits: Full operative main Methods/supplements inaccessible; direct figure-page attempts failed. No heat or sheath-formation experiment reconstructed.

sources.title: Heightened stress response in primary fibroblasts expressing mutant eIF2B genes from CACH/VWM leukodystrophy patients.
sources.operative_scope: Normal and official Europe PMC abstracts; publisher payload inspected and identified as HTML challenge.
sources.finding: Patient eIF2B-mutant fibroblasts show heightened ATF4 response with similar broad translational inhibition/upstream kinase activation.
sources.limits: Specific EIF2B5 genotype and operative experiments unresolved; HTTP200 HTML is not a PDF.

sources.title: An efficient mammalian cell-free translation system supplemented with translation factors.
sources.operative_scope: Verified abstract and independent access assessment; complete operative Methods unavailable.
sources.finding: eIF2/eIF2B supplementation improves HeLa-extract translation; the added factor species/preparation is unresolved in this access scope.
sources.limits: Full operative Methods unavailable; broad complex function has independent support.

sources.title: Ectopic expression of eIF2Bepsilon in rat skeletal muscle rescues the sepsis-induced reduction in guanine nucleotide exchange activity and protein synthesis.
sources.finding: Rat epsilon-FLAG muscle electroporation increases GEF; restores sepsis-depressed synthesis, while healthy-muscle synthesis need not rise.
sources.limits: Rat muscle/homogenate context, not isolated human epsilon activity.

sources.title: Stress responses. Mutations in a translation initiation factor identify the target of a memory-enhancing compound.
sources.operative_scope: Independent original-source consultation: main text and captions read, with supplementary Table S1 and complete purification details unavailable.
sources.finding: Whole-complex GDP release, CHO delta-mutant and mouse-fibroblast contexts are distinct. Purified complex species/construct and the sequence exception cannot be resolved without the missing Methods/table.
sources.limits: Whole-complex exchange and CHO delta-mutant experiments do not establish an isolated-epsilon assay; unread supplementary sequence details remain unresolved.

sources.title: Expression, purification, and crystallization of Schizosaccharomyces pombe eIF2B.

sources.finding: Human eIF2/eIF2B reconstituted-translation comparator exists; detailed purification/crystal work is primarily S. pombe.
sources.limits: Most detailed purification and structural work concerns S. pombe; the human comparator is retained separately.

sources.title: Structure of the nucleotide exchange factor eIF2B reveals mechanism of memory-enhancing molecule.

sources.finding: Five codon-optimized human genes expressed in E. coli; alpha2 plus beta/gamma/delta/epsilon reconstitution and exchange support complex function.
sources.limits: Supplementary exact insert sequence and figure pixels were not inspected; no isolated human epsilon assay claimed.

sources.title: Structural basis for eIF2B inhibition in integrated stress response.
